selection_note: Four cases curated after the sealed blinded review of eleven reserved photographs: a clear original Decisions error, a reasonable granularity difference, a remaining mannequin/category-gap disagreement, and justified shared Other for a cooking appliance. Both the eleven-case review selection and these four illustrations are post hoc qualitative choices, not an accuracy sample. The automated same-family coding-harness review is not human ground truth and its compute is outside the experiment API ledger.
